newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria soon to take new control in banks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria soon to take new control in banks - paper.

text.p: Nigeria's military government will soon take 'Golden Shares' in several of the country's banks, giving it control over directors regardless of its shareholding, a local newspaper reported on Friday.
The independent newspaper Thisday quoted government officials as saying a decree had been drafted and was expected to be signed into law within one month.

Finance Minister Anthony Ani was separately quoted as telling journalists that the idea of acquiring 'Golden Shares', first proposed last year, might now be extended to more than the four banks originaly proposed.
Last year the government proposed taking the shares in the country's four biggest banks; UBA, UBN, First Bank, Afribank.
At the time it said it would help to prevent financial distress in the banking sector if the government had the right to appoint and dismiss directors of the banks.
